project.name: Aligno
project.description: AI-native pipeline-first CRM and workflow command center for agencies, creators, coaches, and consultants.

tech_stack.frontend: Next.js 14 (App Router) with React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

features.name: Project Scaffolding
features.description: Initialize Next.js project with TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase client, testing setup, and folder structure.

tasks.title: Initialize Next.js app with TypeScript and Tailwind
tasks.description: Create Next.js 14 app with App Router, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS, and base layout.
acceptance_criteria: Base app layout with sidebar navigation shell

tasks.title: Configure testing infrastructure
tasks.description: Set up Vitest with React Testing Library, jsdom environment, path aliases, and a sample test.
acceptance_criteria: vitest runs and passes a sample test
React Testing Library configured for component tests

tasks.title: Set up Supabase client and type generation
tasks.description: Install @supabase/supabase-js, configure client for browser and server, create env template.
acceptance_criteria: Supabase client exports for browser and server
Database types file (placeholder until schema exists)

tasks.title: Create app shell with sidebar navigation
tasks.description: Build the persistent sidebar layout with nav items: Home, Pipeline, Projects, Automations, Tasks, Reporting, Settings. Purple sidebar matching design screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar renders with all nav items

features.name: Core CRM Data Model
features.description: Database schema and CRUD operations for contacts, deals, pipelines, stages, tags, tasks, and activity logs.

tasks.title: Create database migration for CRM entities
tasks.description: SQL migration for: workspaces, contacts, deals, pipelines, stages, tags, contact_tags, tasks, activity_logs. Include RLS policies.
acceptance_criteria: All tables created with proper foreign keys

tasks.title: Build TypeScript types and data access layer
tasks.description: Create TypeScript types for all CRM entities and a data access module with create/read/update/archive functions.
acceptance_criteria: Type definitions for Contact, Deal, Pipeline, Stage, Tag, Task, ActivityLog
Data access functions for CRUD on each entity
Unit tests for data access functions (mocked Supabase)

tasks.title: Seed data for development
tasks.description: Create a seed script that populates sample workspace, contacts, deals, pipelines, stages, tags, and tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Seed script creates realistic sample data
At least 2 pipelines, 5 stages each, 10 contacts, 8 deals, 5 tags

features.name: Pipeline View
features.description: Stage-based Kanban pipeline view for managing deals visually.

tasks.title: Build pipeline Kanban board component
tasks.description: Create a drag-and-drop Kanban board showing deals grouped by stage columns. Use @dnd-kit for drag interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Deals displayed as cards in stage columns
Drag and drop moves deals between stages
Stage columns show deal count and total value
Unit tests for pipeline board rendering

tasks.title: Build deal card and deal detail panel
tasks.description: Deal cards show contact name, deal value, owner, and tags. Clicking opens a side panel with full details and edit capability.
acceptance_criteria: Deal card renders key info compactly
Side panel shows full deal details
Edit deal fields inline in panel
Unit tests for deal card and panel

tasks.title: Wire pipeline view to data layer
tasks.description: Connect pipeline page to Supabase data. Pipeline selector dropdown, real-time stage changes, activity log on stage move.
acceptance_criteria: Activity log entry created on stage change

features.name: Business Events System
features.description: Event emission layer that fires when CRM actions occur, enabling workflow triggers.

tasks.title: Create business events schema and service
tasks.description: Database table for business_events. Service module that emits events for contact_created, tag_added, deal_stage_changed, task_created, form_submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Events table with type, payload, workspace_id, record_id, timestamp
Event emitter service with typed payloads
Idempotency key to prevent duplicate processing

tasks.title: Integrate event emission into CRM operations
tasks.description: Wire event emitter into data access layer so CRM CRUD operations automatically emit events.
acceptance_criteria: Moving a deal stage emits deal_stage_changed
Unit tests verify events are emitted on CRM actions

features.name: Workflow Builder - Canvas and Nodes
features.description: Visual workflow builder with React Flow canvas, node types, edge connections, and node settings panel.

tasks.title: Create workflow data model and schema
tasks.description: Database migration for workflows, workflow_versions, workflow_nodes, workflow_edges. TypeScript types for workflow definition.
acceptance_criteria: Tables for workflows, versions, nodes, edges
Workflow status enum: draft, published, archived
Node type enum covering all V1 types

tasks.title: Build React Flow canvas with custom node components
tasks.description: Set up React Flow canvas with dot grid background, zoom controls, and custom node components matching design: rounded squircle shapes with colored accents per type (green=trigger, blue=action, purple=AI, orange=condition, gray=wait).
acceptance_criteria: Canvas renders with dot grid background
Custom node components for trigger, action, AI, condition, wait types
Nodes have rounded squircle shape with type label, title, subtitle
Unit tests for custom node components

tasks.title: Build node settings panel
tasks.description: Right-side panel that opens when a node is selected, showing configuration fields specific to the node type. Cancel/Save buttons at bottom.
acceptance_criteria: Panel opens on node click, closes on X or deselect
Panel renders different forms per node type
Save persists node config to workflow definition
Unit tests for settings panel forms

tasks.title: Build trigger node configuration
tasks.description: Trigger node form supporting contact_created, tag_added, deal_stage_changed, form_submitted. Filter conditions for tag, pipeline, stage, form ID.
acceptance_criteria: Trigger type selector with 4 trigger types
Filter conditions UI per trigger type
Unit tests for trigger node form

tasks.title: Build action node configurations
tasks.description: Action node forms for: send_email, send_sms, add_tag, remove_tag, move_deal_stage, create_task, webhook, stop_workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Each action type has its own form with required fields
send_email: to, subject, body (with variable insertion)
Unit tests for each action node form

tasks.title: Build wait, if/else, and approval node configurations
tasks.description: Wait node with duration input (minutes/hours/days). If/else node with condition rules and two outgoing paths. Approval node that pauses execution.
acceptance_criteria: Wait: duration input with unit selector
If/else: condition builder with field, operator, value rows
Approval: description field and assignee selector
Unit tests for each control node form

tasks.title: Build add-node menu and edge creation
tasks.description: Node palette menu triggered from + button or connection endpoint. Categorized by type. Creating edges between nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Add-node menu shows available node types by category
Clicking a node type adds it to canvas
Dragging from output handle creates edge to target node

tasks.title: Implement workflow save and validation
tasks.description: Save workflow draft to database. Validate workflow definition: must have trigger, no orphan nodes, required fields filled. Show validation errors.
acceptance_criteria: Save draft persists nodes and edges to database
Validation catches: no trigger, orphan nodes, missing required fields
Validation errors displayed clearly in UI
Unit tests for workflow validation logic

features.name: Workflow Publishing and Versioning
features.description: Publish workflow versions as immutable snapshots. Draft edits don't affect published versions.

tasks.title: Implement workflow publishing
tasks.description: Publish action creates an immutable workflow_version record. UI shows draft vs published state. Undo/redo in builder.
acceptance_criteria: Draft edits after publish don't change published version
Publish button disabled when validation fails

features.name: Workflow Enrollment and Execution
features.description: Enroll records into workflows when triggers fire. Execute workflow steps reliably via Trigger.dev.

tasks.title: Create enrollment data model
tasks.description: Database table for workflow_enrollments storing record_id, workflow_version_id, current_node, status, timestamps. Re-enrollment settings.
acceptance_criteria: Status enum: active, completed, failed, canceled

tasks.title: Build trigger-to-enrollment bridge
tasks.description: Service that matches business events to active workflow triggers and creates enrollments for matching records.
acceptance_criteria: Events matched against published workflow triggers
Duplicate enrollments prevented per idempotency rules

tasks.title: Build workflow execution engine (Trigger.dev integration)
tasks.description: Workflow step executor using Trigger.dev for durable execution, waits, retries, and step logging. Each node type has an executor function.
acceptance_criteria: Trigger.dev task definition for workflow execution
Step outcomes logged: completed, failed, skipped, canceled
Unit tests for executor functions (mocked Trigger.dev)

features.name: Email Campaigns
features.description: Send emails from workflows via Resend. Message templates with variable interpolation.

tasks.title: Create message templates system
tasks.description: Database table for message_templates. Template editor with variable interpolation ({{contact.first_name}} etc). Template CRUD.
acceptance_criteria: Templates table with name, subject, body, variables

tasks.title: Integrate Resend for email delivery
tasks.description: Email service that sends via Resend API. Logs delivery status per contact and enrollment. Used by send_email workflow action.
acceptance_criteria: Send email function with template interpolation
Unit tests for email service (mocked Resend)

features.name: AI Workflow Nodes
features.description: AI-native workflow steps: ai_draft_message for generating email/SMS content from CRM context.

tasks.title: Build AI service layer
tasks.description: Internal AI service that wraps model provider calls. Supports prompt templates, context injection, and structured outputs. Provider-agnostic interface.
acceptance_criteria: AI service interface with generate() method
Prompt template rendering with CRM context
Unit tests for AI service (mocked provider)

tasks.title: Build AI draft message node
tasks.description: Workflow node that drafts email/SMS content using AI. Config: prompt template, context fields, output format. Integrates with approval flow.
acceptance_criteria: AI draft node config form in builder
Prompt template textarea with variable insertion
Node executor calls AI service and stores output
Unit tests for AI draft node

features.name: AI Review and Approval
features.description: Review page for AI-generated outputs. Approve, reject, or edit before workflow continues.

tasks.title: Create approval data model
tasks.description: Database tables for approval_requests and approval_actions. Link to enrollment, workflow step, and AI output.
acceptance_criteria: Approval request table with status, content, context
Approval action table with actor, outcome, timestamp
Status enum: pending, approved, rejected, edited

tasks.title: Build AI review page
tasks.description: Minimal review page matching design: draft as hero card, Edit/Reject/Approve & Send buttons, collapsible context section, regenerate action.
acceptance_criteria: Draft displayed as centered card with email fields
Edit, Reject, Approve & Send buttons above draft
Collapsible context section (trigger, source data, prompt)
Approval persists to database and resumes workflow
Unit tests for review page components

tasks.title: Build approvals list page
tasks.description: List view under Automations > Approvals showing pending, approved, and rejected items with filters.
acceptance_criteria: List of approval requests with status badges

features.name: Connected Apps and Webhooks
features.description: Outbound webhook actions and simple integration connection management.

tasks.title: Build webhook action executor
tasks.description: Webhook node executor that sends HTTP requests with configurable URL, method, headers, body. Logs response.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP request sent with configured params
Unit tests for webhook executor (mocked HTTP)

tasks.title: Build integration connections settings page
tasks.description: Settings page for managing integration connections. Store connection metadata securely. Initial support for webhook and email provider connections.
acceptance_criteria: Connections table with name, type, config (encrypted secrets)
Secrets not exposed in UI after save

features.name: Execution Logs
features.description: Enrollment history and step-level execution logs for debugging workflows.

tasks.title: Create execution log data model
tasks.description: Database tables for execution_steps linked to enrollments. Step outcome, timestamp, error messages, provider responses.
acceptance_criteria: Execution steps table with enrollment_id, node_id, outcome, timestamp
Error message field for failed steps
Provider response field for external actions

tasks.title: Build enrollment history page
tasks.description: Page showing enrollments filtered by status (active, completed, failed, canceled), workflow, and contact. Click-through to step log.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for enrollment history components
